about_the_game:
About the Soundtrack

Dive even deeper into the chaos with the official Raining Blood soundtrack — a powerful and atmospheric collection that captures every moment of carnage, every step into madness, and every bullet fired into the endless waves of demonic foes.

Inspired by games like COD Zombies, this soundtrack blends dark ambiance with relentless intensity, enhancing both the tension of brutal combat and the mystery behind the demonic invasion.

Whether you're a seasoned survivor or a newcomer to this hellish world, these tracks are the perfect companion — in or out of the game.

Support the Developers

Purchasing the soundtrack is more than just grabbing some epic music — it's a direct way to support the indie developers who poured their heart, blood, and soul into bringing this world to life. If you enjoyed the game and want to help keep the project alive, this is one of the best ways to show your support.
